engine.version_requirement: PostgreSQL 16+ for the current contract-spike CI

topology.logical_database_isolation: one generated schema per Native logical database in the bounded spike

native.domain-mcp.v1.contract: lifecycle, visibility, history, replay, guarded-write, and isolation slice
native.domain-mcp.v1.notes: Partial aggregate claims are advisory only and never admit a strict operation without a full operation-scoped capability.

native.operation.record-read.v1.notes: SQLite get_record enrichments and optional argument semantics are not implemented by the bounded Postgres handler.

native.operation.record-history.v1.contract: record_id, after_seq, and limit storage slice
native.operation.record-history.v1.notes: Global and authenticated history visibility plus run/order selectors are not contract-proven.

native.operation.link-add.v1.notes: The Postgres slice does not materialize or mutate links.

native.operation.snapshot-export.v1.notes: A Postgres logical schema cannot consume a SQLite physical snapshot.

native.interaction-log.v1.notes: The bounded Postgres registry does not materialize SQLite read_log_calls/read_log_touches; the optional tap must be suppressed.

native.guarded-write.v1.provider: row lock plus transactional digest guard

native.canonical-interchange.v1.provider: validated content-event import with event-cursor and records/facet projection rebuild plus canonical verification
native.canonical-interchange.v1.notes: The bounded spike verifies content_events fields seq/id/record_id/type/payload/actor/created_at (timestamps normalized to UTC microseconds), derived event_cursor.last_seq, records fields id/type/kind/name/body/home_id/summary/lifecycle/owner_id/persistence/maturity/deleted_at presence plus archived derived from facet presence, and facet_values fields record_id/key/value. It does not claim whole-section verification. Non-empty unmaterialized sections are returned in a structured report. Unsupported event types and non-null SQLite-only event annotations fail closed. TIMESTAMPTZ and JSONB normalize timestamp and JSON text; policy, meta, identity, links, bindings, and Message audience state are not yet materialized.

native.search.semantic.v1.notes: No semantic query adapter is part of the bounded Postgres spike.

native.raw-sql.notes: The bounded spike intentionally does not expose query_sql.

native.describe-physical-schema.provider: backend-owned spike DDL and schema_migrations table
